prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In to Keep Your Desktop Companion Safe", "Sign in with existing account to preserve pets, or create a new account safely"]
1: ["Checking screen resolution, desktop overlay permissions, and graphics engine readiness..."]
2: ["Choose between Quiet Observer, Active Companion, or Playful Explorer", "Save Behavior Mode", "Select Companion Desktop Behavior Mode"]
3: ["Right-click pet for Quick Menu | Double-click to talk | Drag to reposition", "Launch Pet on Desktop", "Essential Desktop Pet Controls & Shortcuts"]
4: ["Choose How You Want to Create Your Desktop Pet", "Pick a premade companion or generate a custom pet from photo"]
5: ["Your pet uses low background CPU and auto-pauses during full-screen games or video calls."]
6: ["Once adoption is complete, your pet companion will automatically save to your account and sync across all your desktop devices.", "Your Pet is Permanently Linked to Your Account", "You can view your adopted companions anytime from the desktop tray menu."]
7: ["Ensure good lighting and centered face for optimal 3D pet generation", "Proceed with Selected Photo", "Select Pet Photo Template for Best Results"]
8: ["Check your system tray icon to summon, hide, or adjust pet settings anytime."]
9: ["Having trouble signing in? Click below to try standard browser authentication or guest mode."]

verdicts.problem: Suggests guest mode to bypass or get around the required sign-in step.
